title: Projection with one constructible torsion factor
statement: Let $A$ be a concrete Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with a closed symmetric monoidal, additive tensor structure and functorial flat resolutions. Here an object is finitely generated when a finite set of its underlying elements is contained in no proper subobject: every monomorphism into it whose underlying range contains that set is an isomorphism. Assume small-site sheafification for $A$. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], write $D(T,A)=D(\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A))$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The tensor $\otimes^L$ is the K-flat derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], with $A$ as its coefficient category. Say that $C\in D(T,A)$ is constructible finite-Tor if it has only finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, each is locally constant with finitely generated geometric stalks on a finite locally closed constructible partition, and $C\otimes^L F[0]$ has cohomology in one fixed finite interval for every $A$-valued sheaf $F$. Say its cohomology stalks are torsion if, for each integer $i$ and geometric point $t$, there is an integer $r>0$ with $r\operatorname{id}_{H^i(C)_t}=0$. For a compactifiable morphism $h$, choose a factorization $h=pj$ with $j$ open and $p$ proper, and set $Rh_!=Rp_*j_!$ using that chosen factorization [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be quasi-compact and compactifiable, let $K\in D(X,A)$ and $N\in D(Y,A)$. Assume either $K$ is constructible finite-Tor with torsion cohomology stalks, or $N$ is constructible finite-Tor with torsion cohomology stalks. Then there exists an isomorphism $Rf_!(K\otimes^L Lf^*N)\cong Rf_!K\otimes^L N$.

proof.text: For a compactification f=pj, the formula for exact open extension by zero follows by restricting to the open and its closed complement: the first restriction is the identity tensor comparison and both second restrictions vanish. It remains to commute tensor with the proper derived image.

On a geometric fibre of p, apply torsion proper base change. On each constructible stratum resolve the finite-Tor factor by a bounded complex of flat coefficients. The explicit positive annihilators imply torsion homology for the fibre calculation. Commute the finite sums and finite exact diagrams of the bounded flat calculation with tensor. Use the finite torsion cohomological dimension of the proper fibre to pass from truncations of the other factor to that factor itself, even when it is unbounded. Filtered colimits are exact in A. This gives the fibrewise constant projection isomorphism.

Glue the calculation over the finite constructible stratification using open-closed distinguished triangles. The same calculation applies when the constructible torsion factor is the source factor: resolve that factor and commute the constant target tensor through its compactly supported cohomology. Geometric stalks jointly detect the resulting comparison. Compose with the open-extension comparison to obtain the displayed isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: XVII 5.1.6--5.1.8 and 5.2.6--5.2.9; additive coefficient extension is the remaining formalization, not a claimed direct use of the ring-only theorem
